info.title: kagami
info.description: Kagami is a CLI tool and daemon to import, export and synchronize contacts.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Kagami — polling-first calendar and contact synchronization

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Synchronize contacts between two configured endpoints

options.name: --settings
options.description: Path to one or more settings JSON files to load

options.name: --no-default-settings
options.description: Skip loading embedded default settings [default: False]

options.name: --from
options.description: Source endpoint name (as configured in the settings file)

options.name: --to
options.description: Destination endpoint name or local directory path

options.name: --bidirectional
options.description: Sync in both directions (default: source to destination only) [default: False]

options.name: --reverse
options.description: Sync from destination to source instead of source to destination [default: False]

options.name: --filter
options.description: OData-style filter expression, e.g. "startswith(name,'A')" or "startswith(name,'A') and contains(categories,'Recruiter')"

options.name: --full
options.description: Ignore saved cursors and fetch all rows from both sides, but still skip contacts whose content is already identical [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Ignore cursors and equality checks; treat matched contacts as changed while respecting sync mode and --on-conflict [default: False]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Delete contacts on the destination that no longer exist on the source (or vice versa) [default: False]

options.name: --on-conflict
options.description: Conflict resolution policy: last-write-wins (default), source-wins, destination-wins, skip [default: last-write-wins]

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Prompt before each action is executed [default: False]

options.name: --what-if
options.description: Plan actions without writing any changes [default: False]

options.name: --interval
options.description: Repeat the sync indefinitely with the given delay between runs (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT15M). Without this option the command runs once and exits.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable more detailed logging for this run [default: False]
